title: The Barn Door Stays Dry
synopsis: A light shower tests the completed side shelter. The runoff follows the repaired roof and gutter away from the wagon door, Farmer Ruth returns her green wheelbarrow beneath it, and the puppies settle into a dry afternoon at the farm.
continuity_state: Before: The new side-shelter roof, flashing, gutter and downspout are fitted, but Farmer Ruth has not yet used it or observed a real rain. The adult work area remains closed pending final inspection. The rest of the barn, stored hay and farm machines are unaffected. After: A light spring shower confirms the rebuilt wagon-door shelter sheds rain into the gutter and downspout onto the stone splash patch; the approach by the wagon door stays dry. Farmer Ruth and Mr. Lee complete inspection, remove the barrier and return the existing one-wheel green wheelbarrow to the little shelter. The main red barn, hay, tractor, animals and roads remain unchanged. Jack adds before/after and runoff diagrams to his original blue notebook; the season is complete.
